info.syllabusName: Giao dịch thương mại quốc tế  (International Trade)
info.description:
This subject includes the main parts: Introducing the
methods for international transactions; introducing the conditions of
international trade; bargaining, contracting, and performing foreign
contact.  

Chapter 1: Introduction to International Trade Transactions

Chapter 2: International Trade Terms (Incoterms)

Chapter 3: Contract Price

Chapter 4: Contracts for the international sale of
goods 

Chapter 5: International Payment

Chapter 6: Documents in International Trade

Chapter 7: Execution of the import-export contracts
